ambiguities.text: The specific gas cost values changed by EIP-150 are not listed in this Meta EIP.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Reference EIP-150 directly for the specific gas cost changes. This Meta EIP only coordinates the fork, not the technical details.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'IO-heavy operations' is not precisely defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume IO-heavy operations include SLOAD, SSTORE, BALANCE, EXTCODESIZE, EXTCODECOPY, CALL, CALLCODE, DELEGATECALL, and SUICIDE/SELFDESTRUCT.

implicit_assumptions.description: All network participants (miners) will upgrade to fork-compatible client versions before block 2,463,000.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Chain split between upgraded and non-upgraded nodes, potentially leading to double-spend attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: The increased gas costs accurately reflect the true computational cost of IO operations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If costs are still too low, DoS attacks remain viable. If too high, legitimate smart contracts become economically impractical.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot find alternative underpriced operations to achieve similar DoS effects.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: New DoS vectors could emerge requiring additional emergency forks.
